Key.Original: Gate the unit symbols on a carried tracker. When on, the unit symbols draw only while the local player carries a GPS or a tracker device. Off draws them as before. Default off.
Key.English: Gate the unit symbols on a carried tracker. When on, the unit symbols draw only while the local player carries a GPS or a tracker device. Off draws them as before. Default off.

Key.Original: Log symbology diagnostics to the RPT. Turn this on before reporting a fault.
Key.English: Log symbology diagnostics to the RPT. Turn this on before reporting a fault.

Key.Original: Draw the NATO APP-6(C) map and world symbols over the engine markers and unit icons. The layer hides the engine mission markers locally and restores them when the map closes. The engine 3D unit icons cannot be suppressed and remain. Default off.
Key.English: Draw the NATO APP-6(C) map and world symbols over the engine markers and unit icons. The layer hides the engine mission markers locally and restores them when the map closes. The engine 3D unit icons cannot be suppressed and remain. Default off.

Key.Original: Use the AEE font for the symbology labels when the font assets are present. Off keeps the engine font. The font conversion is an operator step. Default on.
Key.English: Use the AEE font for the symbology labels when the font assets are present. Off keeps the engine font. The font conversion is an operator step. Default on.

Key.Original: Draw the symbology symbols for the engine map markers. Off leaves the markers to the engine. Default on.
Key.English: Draw the symbology symbols for the engine map markers. Off leaves the markers to the engine. Default on.

Key.Original: Choose whose side is blue: NATO fixes WEST, OPFOR fixes EAST, Auto follows the local side. The frame shape and the colour then follow the standard. Default Auto.
Key.English: Choose whose side is blue: NATO fixes WEST, OPFOR fixes EAST, Auto follows the local side. The frame shape and the colour then follow the standard. Default Auto.

Key.Original: Suppress the engine map indicators where the engine allows it and hide the engine mission markers locally while the map is open. The call is disableMapIndicators; the hide is local and restored on close. Default on.
Key.English: Suppress the engine map indicators where the engine allows it and hide the engine mission markers locally while the map is open. The call is disableMapIndicators; the hide is local and restored on close. Default on.

Key.Original: Draw the symbology symbols for the in-range units. Off draws the markers and the player only. Default on.
Key.English: Draw the symbology symbols for the in-range units. Off draws the markers and the player only. Default on.

Key.Original: The affiliation of the dynamic AEE symbol: friend, hostile, neutral or unknown. Default friend.
Key.English: The affiliation of the dynamic AEE symbol: friend, hostile, neutral or unknown. Default friend.

Key.Original: The battle dimension of the dynamic AEE symbol: Land, Air, Sea, Subsurface, Installation, Equipment or Other. Default Land.
Key.English: The battle dimension of the dynamic AEE symbol: Land, Air, Sea, Subsurface, Installation, Equipment or Other. Default Land.

Key.Original: The echelon of the dynamic AEE symbol, from team to region. Default team.
Key.English: The echelon of the dynamic AEE symbol, from team to region. Default team.

Key.Original: The function glyph of the dynamic AEE symbol, from the APP-6(C) taxonomy. Default infantry.
Key.English: The function glyph of the dynamic AEE symbol, from the APP-6(C) taxonomy. Default infantry.

Key.Original: The affiliation palette for the dynamic AEE symbol: NATO, OPFOR or Auto. Default NATO.
Key.English: The affiliation palette for the dynamic AEE symbol: NATO, OPFOR or Auto. Default NATO.
